description_text:
This collection includes 6 types of ancient amphoras. Originally createt with Blender. Previews are rendered with Cycles.

  - Lighting rig and HDRi are not included. 

  - Models are suitable for subdivision.

  - All models share the same material and textures to reduce draw calls in real-time engines.

Geometry:
  - Polygonal (quads only)

  - Modeled in real-world scale (cm)

  - Centered at origin and set to 0,0,0 world-space

  - UV unwrapped, non-overlapping

Amphora 01:

  - Vertices: 462

  - Faces: 444 (888 tris when triangulated)

Amphora 02:

  - Vertices: 542

  - Faces: 528 (1056 tris when triangulated)

Amphora 03:

  - Vertices: 482

  - Faces: 468 (936 tris when triangulated)

Amphora 04:

  - Vertices: 494

  - Faces: 480 (960 tris when triangulated)

Amphora 05:

  - Vertices: 446

  - Faces: 432 (864 tris when triangulated)

Amphora 06:

  - Vertices: 494

  - Faces: 480 (960 tris when triangulated)

Files:.blend(2.79)

  - Models, material and textures included

  - Use this file for Blender version 2.79 or later

  - Principled shader used. The shader will not work in older versions of Blender

.blend(2.78)

  - Models, material and textures included

  - Use this file for Blender version 2.78 or older

  - PBR shader included. This version will work in all Blender versions down to 2.5

Multiformats (.fbx, .obj, .3ds)

  - Models included

  - Textures are provided in the textures download

  - You may have to reapply the textures in your application

.unitypackage

  - Models, materials, textures and prefabs included

  - Import the unitypackage file into your project and you're ready to go

Textures (PBR metalness roughness):
  - Albedo 1024x1024 (.png)

  - Metallic 1024x1024 (.png)

  - Roughness 1024x1024 (.png)

  - Normal 1024x1024 (.png)

Additional textures are provided in the Texures download file.

  - Glossiness 1024x1024 (.png)

  - Normal(Y-) 1024x1024 (.png)

  - Metallic/Smoothness (for unity) 1024x1024 (.png)

The models in this collection are also available as single model. Thanks for your interest and don't forget to click on my name to see more products that might be suitable for you.

Mugo Pine (Pinus mugo)
Shrub/Tree, evergreen conifer  
Origin : Europe (Alps)
Environment : Alpine slopes and thickets, from 1.500 to 2.700 m.
Climate : cool, cold
Notes :
The Mugo Pine is easily recognizable because of the prostrate shape, with dense laying branches pointing upwards. Only rarely it grows tree-tall. It plays a very important role in the Alpine ecosystem, because it shelters young trees and trunks of older trees from the freezing winds. It also creates a natural barrier against avalanches.

European Larch (Larix decidua)
Tree, deciduous conifer  
Origin : Central Europe
Environment : mountains, from 600 to 2.500 m., in full sunlight

Lesser Periwinkle ( Vinca minor )

Herbaceous plant, perennial
Height : .8m to 1.40m included
Origin : Mediterranean
Environment : groundcover in the shade of forests
Climate : warm, mild, temperate

Notes :
The Lesser Periwinkle is a creeping low plant native of the Mediterranean area. It grows as ground species of warm and mild temperate forests, where it literally covers the ground, but it can be found also at the edge of the roads. Its leaves and flowers are symbols of truthfulness, friendship, and remembrance. It was also popular as symbol of virginity. Today it is used extensively in gardening to create flowerbeds.

deciduous broadleaf  
Origin : Europe, South-Western Asia

Tree, deciduous broadleaf  
Origin : Europe (from Norway to Sicily)

Tree, deciduous broadleaf

Paper Mulberry ( Broussonetia papyrifera )  
Tree, broadleaf deciduous, broad spreading
Height : .5m to 9m included
Origin : Pacific Islands, Eastern China, Japan
Environment : wild lands, on any soil, thriving also in full shade
Climate : temperate; stands well both cold and drought  
Notes :
The Paper Mulberry is a very rustic tree that often colonizes wasted lands and ruined buildings or road edges. It was imported from Asia to Europe in the 18th century as ornamental plant. Native Fijians used the bark to make their ceremony clothes.

description_text:
Tree Stump [mossy] Game-ready
Polycount
VertsHigh poly   117,453Mid poly    4,105Low poly    433
The Model contains a Mid poly version, a LOD Version and a high poly version of the mesh. 
The first two are suitable for games (the fbx files), the high poly only for rendering. The pack also contains Two sets of textures for the mid poly and the LOD version. 
The .blend file (Blender) contains all three versions of the meshes. 
The mesh is scanned. It is ultra photorealistic, because its made from a real world object.
The texturepacks contain: 
HQ= high quality textures
-Diffuse for base-Baked normal map (baked from the highpoly model)-Painted Detailed normal map
-LOD Diffuse-Baked LOD normal map
GQ= game quality textures.
-Diffuse for base-Baked normal map (baked from the high poly model)-Painted Detailed normal map
-LOD Diffuse-Baked normal map
If you need a greater resolution for the textures, please ask me, i can create everything up to 10.000x10.000
Work:
The Wall is a scanned real life object, which is used in 3D environments . The work contains:
1.finding the object2.making many pictures3.Computing the orientation and location of the pictures in Agisoft's Photoscann4.Computing a high quality pointcloude5.making a highpoly mesh6.baking the textures from the photos to the mesh
7.bring all the stuff into blender8.creating the mid- and low poly object9.Baking the textures and normalmaps, as well as creating uv's

The first two are suitable for games (the fbx files), the high poly only for rendering. The pack also contains Two sets of textures for the mid poly and the LOD version. 
The mesh is scanned. It is ultra photorealistic, because its made from a real world object.
The texturepacks contain: 
HQ= high quality textures
-Diffuse for base-Baked normal map (baked from the highpoly model)-Painted Detailed normal map
-LOD Diffuse-Baked LOD normal map
GQ= game quality textures.
-Diffuse for base-Baked normal map (baked from the high poly model)-Painted Detailed normal map
-LOD Diffuse-Baked normal map
If you need a greater resolution for the textures, please ask me, i can create everything up to 10.000x10.000
Work:
The Object is a scanned real life object, which is used in 3D environments . The work contains:
1.finding the object2.making many pictures3.Computing the orientation and location of the pictures in Agisoft's Photoscann4.Computing a high quality pointcloude5.making a highpoly mesh6.baking the textures from the photos to the mesh
7.bring all the stuff into blender8.creating the mid- and low poly object9.Baking the textures and normalmaps, as well as creating uv's

The family Phylliidae (often misspelled Phyllidae) contains the extant true leaf insects or walking leaves, which include some of the most remarkably camouflaged leaf mimics in the entire animal kingdom.
